newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - April 18.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- The Supreme court upheld the lower court sentences of life in jail for former president Chun Doo Hwan and 17 years for his successor Roh Tae-woo.
- Prosecutors will summon former deputy prime minister Rha Woong-bae and ex-lawmaker Hwang Myung-soo for questioning on suspicion that they received money from troubled Hanbo Group.
- The Supreme Court upheld the not-guilty verdict by a lower court for Chung Tae-soo, the founder of the Hanbo Group, in a corruption trial involving former presidents Chun Doo Hwan and Roh Tae-woo.
- Talk of granting amnesty to former presidents Chun Doo Hwan and Roh Tae-woo is actively circulating among ruling and opposition parties.
- The Asian Development Bank and North Korea may start talks later this year on the Pyongyang's membership to the organization, the bank's spokesman said on Thursday.
